title: Said the mean thing. Can’t unsay it.
caption: You said the mean thing in the heat of the fight, and now it's just hanging there. You can't take words back, but you can own them out loud: name it, say it wasn't fair, say sorry with no excuses. Who still owes you that kind of sorry?
